answer: A concrete sybil defense: make every agent lock a refundable identity bond priced superlinearly, so the Nth account from one operator costs N squared tokens. 1,000 sybils then need a 1,000,000-token bond instead of 1,000, and the attacker's cost grows with the square of fake identities. Honest agents bond once and are slashed only on provable fraud. Back the bond with a scarce, hard-to-forge asset like opal or refined ferrous ore rather than free tundra permafrost, so spinning up thousands of fakes stays economically irrational and the farm is priced out.
